# UI elements

<!-- GENERATED by tools/ui-index/build-ui-index.mjs from the docblock tags
     in libs/ui. Do not edit: change the element's tags and run
     `pnpm ui:index`. -->

Every element the design system exports, and what to reach for when.
Look here before writing any control in a template. A feature never
styles a native control or builds its own; a new element is added to
`libs/ui` only when the owner asks for one.

| `ui-sheet-action-bar`                                         | The bottom action row docked to a sheet's bottom edge, the primary action at the trailing edge, floating over the scrolling body.                             | `.safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) { HStack { … } }` on a sheet                                                       | On a full-height page the bottom row is `ui-page-action-bar`.                                                                                                        |
| `ui-sheet-header`                                             | The top bar of a sheet or a page: the grabber, a compact title that lands when the large title scrolls under it, and trailing actions.                        | a navigation bar whose large title collapses to `.navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)` on scroll               | The large title in the content, with the lines under it, is `ui-sheet-headline`; a plain bar of controls is `ui-toolbar`.                                            |
| `ui-sheet-headline`                                           | The head of a sheet page in its content: the large title, up to two quiet lines under it and an optional face, folding away while a search is engaged.        | a large `.navigationTitle` with a `.navigationSubtitle`; the fold is the `.searchable` grammar                    | The bar pinned above it, with the grabber and the compact title, is `ui-sheet-header`; a heading inside the page is `ui-section-header`.                             |
| `ui-status-indicator`                                         | A flat status line: a coloured dot, the state in words (open, closed, available) and an optional quiet detail after it.                                       | a `Label` whose icon is `Circle().fill(tone)`                                                                     | A state drawn as a tinted capsule is `uiBadge`.                                                                                                                      |
| `ui-stepper`                                                  | A progress trail through the steps of a flow: a row of thin segments showing which step of a short, fixed sequence you are on.                                | App pattern                                                                                                       | This is NOT a − / + counter: that is `ui-count-stepper` (SwiftUI `Stepper`). Loading progress is `ui-progress-view`; dots for swipeable pages are `ui-page-control`. |
| `ui-streak-track`                                             | Draws a streak: the count of periods kept in a row over the last few periods, with kept, protected, missed and open marks.                                    | App pattern                                                                                                       | The steps of a flow are `ui-stepper`; a single share of a whole is `ui-gauge`.                                                                                       |
| `ui-swipe-actions`                                            | Quick actions behind a list row, revealed by swiping it sideways: wrap a row and project the action buttons.                                                  | `.swipeActions(edge:allowsFullSwipe:)`                                                                            | A row's actions that are always visible are a `ui-menu` on a trailing «⋯»; verbs under a person are `ui-quick-actions`.                                              |
| `ui-toast`                                                    | A transient receipt docked at the bottom: one sentence saying what just happened, one action (undo) and a timed dismiss.                                      | App pattern                                                                                                       | A message that stays in the page is `ui-notice`; a question that must be answered before anything else is `ui-alert`.                                                |
| `button[uiCouponCard], article[uiCouponCard]`                 | A ticket-shaped card for one offer: its value, name and code over a tear line, with its conditions and the call to use it.                                    | App pattern                                                                                                       | A plain content surface is `ui-card`.                                                                                                                                |

| Part                                                                 | Belongs to          | What it is for                                                                                                                |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ui-rich-text-runs`                                                  | `ui-rich-text`      | Prints one block's runs: plain, bold, italic, and links.                                                                      |
| `[uiHeadlineMedia]`                                                  | `ui-sheet-headline` | Marks the one projected avatar or medal as the headline's face.                                                               |
| `[uiHeadlinePlate]`                                                  | `ui-sheet-headline` | Marks the badge that stands on the lower rim of a hero headline's face, such as a client's tier.                              |
| `button[uiMenuItem], a[uiMenuItem], label[uiMenuItem], [uiMenuItem]` | `ui-menu`           | One action of the menu, on a button, a link or a file-picker label; an option or a tick box when the menu expresses a choice. |
| `[uiMenuTrigger]`                                                    | `ui-menu`           | Marks the control that opens the menu, so the surface anchors to it and the control announces what it opens.                  |
| `a[uiQuickAction], button[uiQuickAction]`                            | `ui-quick-actions`  | One verb of the run: a link or a button drawn as a glyph on a round disc with its word under it.                              |
| `button[uiSwipeAction]`                                              | `ui-swipe-actions`  | One quick action revealed by swiping a row: a tinted segment with a glyph over a short word.                                  |

## modifiers

Import from `@creativo/ui/modifiers`.

| Element                                                   | What it is for                                                                                                                        | SwiftUI                                                                                        | Not this when                                                                                        |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[uiFont]`                                                | Sets an element's text style from the type scale (title, headline, body, caption).                                                    | `.font(_:)`                                                                                    | Font, weight and colour together on one element are `uiText`.                                        |
| `[uiForegroundStyle]`                                     | Sets an element's text and glyph colour from the semantic ink styles.                                                                 | `.foregroundStyle(_:)`                                                                         |                                                                                                      |
| `[uiFrame]`                                               | Sizes an element: a fixed width or height, a centred max-width column, or full width.                                                 | `.frame(width:height:)` / `.frame(maxWidth:)`, `.frame(maxWidth: .infinity)` for full width    |                                                                                                      |
| `[uiInteractive]`                                         | Gives a tappable surface (a card, row or tile) the shared hover and press highlight.                                                  | `.hoverEffect(.highlight)`                                                                     | It only draws the highlight; a control that performs an action is `uiButton`, which carries its own. |
| `a[uiLink], button[uiLink]`                               | Styles an anchor or button as an underlined text link inside a sentence.                                                              | `Link`, or a Markdown link inside `Text`                                                       | A standalone action such as a footer link is a plain `uiButton`.                                     |
| `[uiMaterial]`                                            | Gives chrome a translucent blurred glass background in one of three thicknesses.                                                      | `.background(.thinMaterial)` / `.background(.regularMaterial)` / `.background(.thickMaterial)` |                                                                                                      |
| `[uiMultilineTextAlignment]`                              | Aligns the wrapped lines of a text block to the leading edge, the centre or the trailing edge.                                        | `.multilineTextAlignment(_:)`                                                                  | Positioning sibling boxes is the alignment of `ui-stack`, not this.                                  |
| `[uiOverlay]`                                             | Turns an element into a layer that covers its positioned parent: a hairline ring, a media scrim, a vignette or a bare layer.          | `.overlay(alignment:content:)`                                                                 |                                                                                                      |
| `[uiPadding], [uiPaddingHorizontal], [uiPaddingVertical]` | Pads an element on all edges, horizontally or vertically, with a token spacing step.                                                  | `.padding(_:)` / `.padding(.horizontal, _:)` / `.padding(.vertical, _:)`                       |                                                                                                      |
| `[uiRadius]`                                              | Rounds an element's corners with a token radius.                                                                                      | `.clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius:))`                                                  |                                                                                                      |
| `[uiReorderList]`                                         | Lets the items of a list be arranged: reports a drag of an item's handle, or an arrow key on it, as a move from one place to another. | `List` with `.onMove(perform:)` and `EditButton`                                               | A value dragged along a range is `ui-slider`.                                                        |
| `[uiReveal]`                                              | Plays the one entrance animation when an element scrolls into view or first renders.                                                  | `.scrollTransition(_:axis:transition:)` / `.transition(_:)`                                    |                                                                                                      |
| `[uiText]`                                                | Sets font, weight and colour on a piece of text in one attribute.                                                                     | `Text` with `.font(_:)`, `.fontWeight(_:)` and `.foregroundStyle(_:)`                          |                                                                                                      |
| `[uiVisuallyHidden]`                                      | Hides an element from sight while screen readers still read it.                                                                       | App pattern                                                                                    |                                                                                                      |
| `[uiWeight]`                                              | Overrides the font weight that an element's text style carries.                                                                       | `.fontWeight(_:)`                                                                              |                                                                                                      |

| Part                | Belongs to      | What it is for                                                                                    |
| ------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[uiReorderHandle]` | `uiReorderList` | The handle an item of a reorderable list is dragged by; arrow keys on it move the item one place. |

## charts

Import from `@creativo/ui/charts`.

| Element         | What it is for                                                                                                              | SwiftUI                                                                              | Not this when                                                                   |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ui-bar-chart`  | A full bar chart: labelled vertical or horizontal bars, stacked parts, an optional value grid, and bars that can be picked. | Swift Charts `BarMark`                                                               | A tiny axis-less graph inside a card is `ui-spark-bars`.                        |
| `ui-heatmap`    | A grid of cells tinted by value, such as weekday by hour.                                                                   | Swift Charts `RectangleMark`                                                         |                                                                                 |
| `ui-line-chart` | A full line chart of one period against a comparison period, with an average rule and end labels.                           | Swift Charts `LineMark`, with `AreaMark` for the fill and `RuleMark` for the average | A tiny axis-less trend inside a card is `ui-spark-line`.                        |
| `ui-radar`      | A radar chart: one polygon over several axes, with an optional comparison outline.                                          | App pattern                                                                          |                                                                                 |
| `ui-ring-chart` | A donut chart of shares of a total, with a slot for a figure in the hole.                                                   | Swift Charts `SectorMark` with an `innerRadius`                                      | One value shown as progress toward a goal is `ui-progress-ring` or `ui-gauge`.  |
| `ui-spark-bars` | A tiny bar graph without axes or words, for a card.                                                                         | Swift Charts `BarMark` in a `Chart` with its axes hidden                             | A chart with labels, a value grid or bars that can be picked is `ui-bar-chart`. |
| `ui-spark-line` | A tiny trend line without axes or words, beside a dashed comparison line, for a card.                                       | Swift Charts `LineMark` and `AreaMark` in a `Chart` with its axes hidden             | A chart with an average rule and printed values is `ui-line-chart`.             |

## icons

Import from `@creativo/ui/icons`.

| Element   | What it is for                                                                             | SwiftUI                          | Not this when                 |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `ui-icon` | Draws one icon from the registry by its semantic name, as an inline SVG sized to the text. | `Image(systemName:)`             | The brand mark is `ui-logo`.  |
| `ui-logo` | Draws the brand mark, in the light or dark cut the theme asks for.                         | `Image(_:)` with the brand asset | Any other glyph is `ui-icon`. |
